alt: A short film with no voice, with music. A room with a front door. A small ink-black block figure with white eyes stands on the left with a closed book standing on the floor on the right. A speech bubble says how hard can it be? It narrows its eyes, walks over and leans toward the book, which opens and turns pages while bubbles say step one... and oh, step four! Its eyes go wide, then happy with a pulse. The text stays: me reading the steps first. The last card: Choose friction.
